R0010.title: Unauthorized Third-Party Top-Up Services
R0010.definition: Providing low-price top-up services that bypass official legitimate recharge channels.
R0010.description: Obtaining low-cost top-up resources through promotional, non-compliant, or illegal means, and offering top-up services externally.
R0010.influence: Affects the normal operations and profitability of game operators.

references.title: Crackdown on Cyber Black-Grey Market: Putuo Prosecution Recovers 100 Million in Proxy Recharge Case

observables: Payment sources of top-up orders concentrate on a few third-party proxy-payment channels or unofficial payment accounts
Top-up amounts for many users deviate from official pricing, showing obvious low-price discount characteristics
Top-up accounts show abnormally clustered relationships with the actual payer, device, and IP
Proxy top-up services solicit customers openly on third-party platforms, with scaled low-price top-up products listed for sale
